title: A connected finite etale scheme is a connected object of the Galois category
statement: Let $Y$ be a connected scheme with a geometric point $\bar y\to Y$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. If $f:P\to Y$ is a finite etale morphism [def-galois-categories] and $P$ is connected as a scheme, then $(P,f)$ is a connected object of the category $\mathrm{F\acute Et}(Y)$: it is noninitial, and every noninitial subobject of $(P,f)$ is isomorphic to it.
